# GoalFinder

> > Educational science animation platform featuring interactive physics, chemistry, and biology software with atomic theory models from Dalton, Rutherford, Bohr, and Millikan, plus nanotechnology content on fullerenes and nanotubes.

GoalFinder provides Flash-based animated science software and educational movies for K-12 schools and colleges, including interactive games like the Quantum Jump Game and comprehensive curricula covering atomic theory, proteomics, and science fundamentals. The platform offers subscriptions, individual product purchases, and free educational tools for distance learning and classroom instruction.

## Key Topics

- Atomic Theory and Models
- Dalton Atomic Theory
- Rutherford Model
- Bohr Atomic Model
- Millikan Oil Drop Experiment
- Quantum Jump Game
- Fullerene and Buckyball
- Carbon Nanotubes
- Flash Animations
- Science Education Software
- Physics, Chemistry, Biology
- Interactive Educational Games
- K-12 Learning Resources
- Proteomics and Genomics
- Nanotechnology
